title: Missing item: refund just that item
tricky: Customer only knows his phone, not the email on file, and has an older order with the same item.

source.what_we_took: Customer opens with a general 'question about my order', explains only when asked, and sends identifiers one message at a time.

resolution_summary: Verify by phone, look up O-5102, refund $4.50 for the garlic naan to the card.

user.persona: Daniel Reyes, a grad student. Friendly, types in lowercase, short messages.
user.situation: You got your Saffron Lane order tonight (chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, mango lassi) but the garlic naan wasn't in the bag.
user.goal: Get your money back for the naan, on your card. If offered credit, say you'd rather have it back on your card.
facts: Your full name is Daniel Reyes.
You're not sure which email is on the account (maybe an old one), so you can't give it.
The garlic naan was missing; everything else was there.
reveal_rules: Say only that your order was incomplete at first; name the missing naan when asked what was missing.
Give the order number only when asked.
behaviors: If asked for your email, say you're not sure which one is on the account and offer your phone.
If asked whether you want a refund or credit, choose the refund to your card.
user.opening: hey, question about my order from tonight
user.end_condition: the agent confirms a refund for the naan, or clearly refuses.

mistakes.name: credit instead of the refund he asked for
